where: Section 3, exam traps and Quiz Q5
problem: Class A, B and C are the standard SAE speed classes. Class D is not part of that standard classification; it appears only in some syllabi and textbooks for safety-critical/time-triggered buses. The chapter hedges once in Section 3, but the quiz then asks students to 'name bus classes A to D' as if all four were standard, and the answer gives Class D as fact.
fix: Keep A, B and C as the standard classes and say 'some textbooks add a Class D for safety-critical, time-triggered buses such as FlexRay or TTP'. In Quiz Q5 reword to 'Name the standard bus classes A to C and their typical use; mention the extra Class D used by some syllabi.'

problem: 'Do not treat the letters as order of speed without checking' contradicts the rates just given, where A < B < C in bit rate. A student can read it as saying the letter order carries no speed meaning at all.
fix: Say: 'The letters A to C do follow increasing speed in the usual classification, but the exact rates differ between standards, so quote the rate, not just the letter.'
